column1: Table 2: Annualised mean return, SD and Sharpe ratio of the four optimal portfolios

Note: Sharpe ratio = (annualised mean return - risk-free rate) / annualised SD (eq. 12). Risk-free rate = 4.21% p.a.: 3-month US Treasury bill, bond-equivalent yield (BEY), source S&P Capital IQ, as of 3 Nov 2026. It is used only as the Sharpe-ratio benchmark; no risk-free asset is held in any portfolio. Percentages at 2 dp and Sharpe ratios at 3 dp for display only.

Source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 1.2.0; daily prices adjusted for splits and dividends (auto_adjust=True), downloaded 2026-11-04 11:32:29 UTC. Sample: last-trading-day month-end prices 30 Sep 2016 to 30 Sep 2026, i.e. 120 monthly simple returns (Oct 2016 - Sep 2026). Currency: USD (all 15 are US listings; no currency conversion). Annualisation: mean x 12, SD x sqrt(12), covariance x 12.
